notes: Phobos Shipbreaker loose materials: furnace housing stock, ingots (Manufacturing raw stock), terminal remainders and the reclaimer and feed-family reject packets. Kinds name how the code builds them: furnace-packet and furnace-housing clone the residue packet with their own art; reclaimer-packet and reject are one-cell packets. Terminal items are priced at the technical minimum by authoring rule. A material's kg is bound to the recipes and family budgets that use it.

PhobosFurnaceHousingBlank.notes: F6 housing blank, the revision-1 furnace product.

PhobosFurnaceHousing.notes: Finished housing from the assembly table.

PhobosFurnaceMeltRemainder.notes: Terminal: dross and skimmings of an aluminium melt.

PhobosAluminiumIngot.notes: Rivetline aluminium ingot, Manufacturing raw stock; priced above the four scraps it holds.

PhobosSteelIngot.notes: Rivetline steel ingot, Manufacturing raw stock.

PhobosSteelMeltRemainder.notes: Terminal: the steel melt's own remainder.

PhobosPanelResidueR2.notes: Identified 13 kg residue packet from revision-2 wall jobs, the R4 feed.

PhobosFloorRejectR1.notes: Terminal one-kilogram reject of the floor grate family; stacks to ten.

PhobosDuraWalRejectR1.notes: Terminal: laminated cladding of a DuraWal panel.

PhobosWindowRejectR1.notes: Terminal: glazing and seals of a window panel.
